# Portfolio 2: Query Processing and Optimisation

**Case study:** Josh Kay's Fisheries. **DBMS:** PostgreSQL 16.
**Data:** synthetic, generated by `seed.sql` (repeatable via `setseed`): 2,000 customers, 16 products, 50,000 orders, 125,000 order lines, ~123,000 stock movements, ~48,000 payments and deliveries.

## Files
| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `seed.sql` | Generates the synthetic dataset (run after Portfolio 1 `schema.sql`) |
| `queries/q1..q5*.sql` | The five business queries |
| `indexes.sql` | Indexes added after reading the BEFORE plans |
| `run_plans.sh` | Runs each query twice (warm cache) and saves `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` output |
| `plans/before_*.txt`, `plans/after_*.txt` | Execution plan evidence |

## How to reproduce
```bash
psql -d fisheries -f ../portfolio-1-database-design/schema.sql
psql -d fisheries -f seed.sql
./run_plans.sh before
psql -d fisheries -f indexes.sql
./run_plans.sh after
```

## Queries
1. **Q1** Order history for one customer (customer service lookup)
2. **Q2** Monthly revenue, last 90 days
3. **Q3** Delivered revenue by delivery zone, last 30 days
4. **Q4** Orders with pending payment plus customer phone (follow-up list)
5. **Q5** Stock movement history for one product, last 30 days

## Results (execution time, ms, single warm run on my machine)
| Query | Before | After | Change | Plan change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 customer history | 2.94 | 0.39 | ~7.5x faster | Seq Scan on `orders` to Bitmap Index Scan on `idx_orders_customer` |
| Q2 monthly revenue | 64.92 | 48.44 | ~1.3x | `orders` Seq Scan to Bitmap Index Scan on `idx_orders_date`; `order_item` still Seq Scan |
| Q3 revenue by zone | 35.44 | 31.29 | ~1.1x | Little change |
| Q4 unpaid orders | 19.42 | 14.24 | ~1.4x | `payment` Seq Scan to Index Scan on partial index |
| Q5 stock history | 9.51 | 1.61 | ~5.9x | Seq Scan to Bitmap Index Scan on composite index |
